The verifier finds the largest 4-connected non-background object (the "center block"), then for every other object draws a ray from its center in the direction pointing away from the center block, painting with that object's own color.

Let me build three inputs: one that reproduces the given example's structure, one with a 2×2 center and four differently-colored corner objects (to show color preservation and all four diagonal directions), and one with a 3×3 center.
